bullets_en: Tiger Shroff attack: Eknath Shinde meets actor, bandages visible.
IMD issued a weather alert for Chennai, reports suggest.
Congress says ex-MLA pressured to join BJP, refused after Rahul Gandhi’s intervention.
Andhra civic polls: TDP- YSRCP workers clash during nomination process; many hurt.
15 injured as TGSRTC bus hits parked lorry on Hyderabad outskirts.
bullets_ur: Tiger Shroff par hamla: Eknath Shinde ki adakar se mulaqat, pattiyan wazeh nazar aaeen.
Reports ke mutabiq IMD ne Chennai ke liye mausam ka alert jaari kiya.
Congress: Sabiq MLA par BJP join karne ka dabao tha, Rahul Gandhi ki mudakhilat ke baad inkar kiya.
Andhra civic polls: Namzadgi ke dauran TDP aur YSRCP karkunan mein jharap, mutaddad afraad zakhmi.
Hyderabad ke nawahi ilaqay mein TGSRTC bus khari lorry se takra gayi, 15 afraad zakhmi.
